notes.title: ENGLISH LANGUAGE UPDATE
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

Today we have a great update, especially for our English-speaking audience!

Caramel performance finally got voiced verion on English!! Now you can freely play it if you didnt get chance before.

DETAILS OF THE UPDATE IN GAME: 


English voice acting added
Updated, better translation on English
Fixed some of the Russian language errors
"About the game" changed
Default game language changed to English
Fixed error with line skips
Upgrated choice menu


We have also added our social medias to our steam page, so make sure to check those out!
